body:
Yes i know, the problem is that our repository is a private project hosted on bitbucket.
Its Laravel with Webpack and Laravel-mix like this:
[Using Laravel Mix with webpack](https://scotch.io/tutorials/using-laravel-mix-with-webpack-for-all-your-assets)
We are using npm for all the node_modules packaging stuff. Thats our actual package.json:

Our webpack.mix.js is:

const mix = require('laravel-mix');
const webpack = require('webpack');

const extract = [
    'jquery',
    'sweetalert',
    'instantsearch.js',
    'slick-carousel'  
];

mix.autoload({
    //instantsearch: ['instantsearch'],
    jquery: ['$', 'jQuery', 'jquery']
});

and then comes all the mix.stuff like mix.sass/mix.copy/mix.js and so on

Our app.js starts with:

window.$ = require('jquery');
require('bootstrap-sass');
window.noUiSlider = require('nouislider');
window.instantsearch = require('instantsearch.js');
$(function(){ ...

If i change the line "instantsearch.js": "2.0.2" to "instantsearch.js": "^2.0.2" and make a npm update and the a npm run dev the compiling process is successful but if i reload the page in the browser i am getting Reference errors like "ReferenceError: $ is not defined" to this line "$(function()" in a different includes of our own JS Files.

And on the Page with the Instantsearch we are getting the error the "window.instantsearch isnt existing" and so on.
